entries.title: Psalms 56:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On Jonathelem-rechokim. Of David. Michtam; when the Philistines took him in Gath.>> Be gracious unto me, O God; for man would swallow me up: all the day long fighting he oppresseth me.

entries.title: Psalms 56:2
segments: Mine enemies would swallow [me] up all the day long; for they are many that fight against me haughtily.

entries.title: Psalms 56:3
segments: In the day that I am afraid, I will confide in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 56:4
segments: In God will I praise his word, in God I put my confidence: I will not fear; what can flesh do unto me?

entries.title: Psalms 56:5
segments: All the day long they wrest my words; all their thoughts are against me for evil.

entries.title: Psalms 56:6
segments: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves; they mark my steps, because they wait for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 56:7
segments: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God.

entries.title: Psalms 56:8
segments: ¶*Thou* countest my wanderings; put my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

entries.title: Psalms 56:9
segments: Then shall mine enemies return backward in the day when I call: this I know, for God is for me.

entries.title: Psalms 56:10
segments: In God will I praise [his] word; in Jehovah will I praise [his] word.

entries.title: Psalms 56:11
segments: In God have I put my confidence: I will not fear; what can man do unto me?

entries.title: Psalms 56:12
segments: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render thanks unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 56:13
segments: For thou hast delivered my soul from death; [wilt thou] not [keep] my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
